raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation
With MegaGate on (`SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_GATE=1`), `run_mega_gate` rebuilds the valid-row mask (`arange < num_token_non_padded`) and the image-token mask (`input_ids == image_token_id`) in every MoE layer, though both depend only on the batch. In DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode this is three small kernels per gate call, serialized ahead of the gate on the MoE stream, in every layer of every step.

## Modifications
- `mega_gate.py`: `mega_gate_forward_scope(forward_batch)` installs a per-forward dict on `forward_batch`; `_gate_row_masks` builds the two masks on the first MoE layer and returns them to the rest (keyed by row count and the identity of the inputs). Under CUDA graphs the capture records one build.
- `mega_moe.py`: pass `forward_batch` to `run_mega_gate`.
- `deepseek_v4.py`, `deepseek_v4_dspark.py`: wrap `forward` in the scope.

No behavior change when MegaGate is off.

## Accuracy Tests
GSM8K (`sglang.test.run_eval`, 5-shot, 1,314 examples, temperature 0, thinking off), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DP attention + EP 8, MegaGate + `SGLANG_DSV4_KV_LAYOUT=v41_new`: same score before and after.

## Speed Tests and Profiling
Decode, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DP attention + EP 8 on GB300, MegaGate + `v41_new`, 8 to 256 running requests per rank: 0.25-0.35 ms less per step at every batch size (1.1-2.3%), from the server's `Decode batch` lines. In a GPU trace, the arange / int compare / int64 compare launches ahead of the gate go from one set per MoE layer to one per forward.

## Checklist
- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (Internal helper; validated end to end above.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

-def run_mega_gate(moe, hidden_states, input_ids, buf=None) -> Optional[MegaGateRouting]:
+@contextmanager
+def mega_gate_forward_scope(forward_batch):
+    """One model forward: the gate's row masks are built once and shared by its
+    MoE layers. Each forward (eager, warmup or graph capture) builds its own."""
+    if forward_batch is None or not envs.SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_GATE.get():
+        yield
+        return
+    try:
+        setattr(forward_batch, _ROW_MASKS_ATTR, {})
+    except (AttributeError, TypeError):
+        yield
+        return
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        try:
+            delattr(forward_batch, _ROW_MASKS_ATTR)
+        except AttributeError:
+            pass
+
+
+def _gate_row_masks(moe, num_tokens, bound, image_input_ids, device, forward_batch):
+    """(valid-row mask, image-token mask) for the gate, built once per forward."""
+    cache = getattr(forward_batch, _ROW_MASKS_ATTR, None)
+    key = (
+        num_tokens,
+        id(bound) if bound is not None else None,
+        id(image_input_ids) if image_input_ids is not None else None,
+    )
+    if isinstance(cache, dict):
+        hit = cache.get(key)
+        # The cached inputs are held, so their ids cannot be reused this forward.
+        if hit is not None and hit[0] is bound and hit[1] is image_input_ids:
+            return hit[2], hit[3]
+    valid = None
+    if bound is not None:
+        valid = (
+            torch.arange(num_tokens, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+            < bound.reshape(-1)[:1]
+        )
+    image = None
+    if image_input_ids is not None:
+        image = (image_input_ids[:num_tokens] == moe.config.image_token_id).contiguous()
+    if isinstance(cache, dict):
+        cache[key] = (bound, image_input_ids, valid, image)
+    return valid, image
+
+
